podcast.body: This song was covered by Bauhaus, and David Bowie himself "just loved what Bajaus had done with" it, contributing to his admiration for the band and their appearance in "The Hunger." "Bowie just loved what Bajaus had done with one of his old songs. That cover of Ziggy Startost..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About Bauhaus?

podcast.body: This song was part of the encore performed by David Bowie at the Hurricane Festival in Schleswig, Germany, on June 25, 2004. After completing this performance, Bowie collapsed backstage following his heart attack. "after a non-core that featured Ziggy Stardust, he made his way down the stairs of the stage and then collapsed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
